railway-paas-breach-exposes-ai-provider-.one_liner: Stolen AI provider API keys from a Railway platform-as-a-service breach in October led to approximately $740,000 in fraudulent usage charges.

fortinet-patches-nearly-100-vulnerabilit.title: Fortinet patches nearly 100 vulnerabilities using AI-assisted testing
fortinet-patches-nearly-100-vulnerabilit.one_liner: Fortinet released patches for approximately 100 vulnerabilities, enabled by integration of frontier AI models into its security testing process.

nasa-escapade-smallsats-successfully-com.title: NASA ESCAPADE Smallsats Successfully Complete Earth Flybys en Route to Mars
nasa-escapade-smallsats-successfully-com.one_liner: NASA's two ESCAPADE smallsats completed Earth flybys and are headed to Mars. The second spacecraft passed within approximately 1,050 kilometers of Earth on November 9, marking the first NASA mission to use powered flyby maneuvers to reach Mars.
takeaways: Second spacecraft (Gold) Earth flyby on Nov 9, 2026 at ~1,050 km altitude
First NASA spacecraft to use powered flyby maneuver for Mars trajectory
Built by Rocket Lab, launched nearly one year before Earth flybys

spacexs-grok-build-ai-coding-agent-expos.title: SpaceX's Grok Build AI coding agent exposed sensitive user data through security vulnerability
spacexs-grok-build-ai-coding-agent-expos.one_liner: A vulnerability in SpaceX's Grok Build exposed sensitive data through discoverable shareable links. SpaceX leaked onboarding plans, sales maps, advertising proposals, and playbooks; exposure also affected hospitals, fire departments, and Fortune 500 companies.
takeaways: Grok Build links used randomized four-word phrases but positioned entropy left of domain (discoverable via DNS)
SpaceX leaked: onboarding plans, 594-account sales territory map, 8 X advertising proposals, brand playbooks
Exposure affected 6 Fortune 500 companies and 26 organizations with 1,000+ employees
Only 1 of exposed apps required password; ~2% of material rated high/critical severity

google-accelerates-ai-performance-by-rem.title: Google Accelerates AI Performance by Removing Python from Query Pipeline
google-accelerates-ai-performance-by-rem.one_liner: Google open-sourced XSE (XLA Serving Engine), which handles over six million queries per second for Search, Ads, and YouTube Shorts without Python in its serving pipeline. The C++ runtime delivers 2–5x throughput of optimized Python servers while using a quarter of the memory.
takeaways: XSE handles 6+ million queries per second across Search, Ads, YouTube Shorts
2–5x throughput improvement vs. optimized Python; quarter the memory usage
Workflow: Python/JAX model code exported via StableHLO to C++ runtime with XLA compilation
Integration with TorchTPU planned for PyTorch users

ai-chatbot-fails-to-flag-suicide-plannin.title: AI Chatbot Fails to Flag Suicide Planning Query on School-Issued Device for Weeks
ai-chatbot-fails-to-flag-suicide-plannin.one_liner: A 13-year-old used Google Gemini on a school Chromebook to research suicide methods, but the school's monitoring systems did not detect the concerning activity for weeks.

researchers-achieve-controlled-reversal-.title: Researchers Achieve Controlled Reversal of Cell Aging in Breakthrough De-Aging Study
researchers-achieve-controlled-reversal-.one_liner: German researchers successfully reversed human cell age by decades through a gradual de-aging process, enabling better tracking of cellular rejuvenation.

global-south-language-models-inherit-tok.title: Global South language models inherit tokenization and knowledge disadvantages from base models
global-south-language-models-inherit-tok.one_liner: Research reveals that fine-tuned language models in the Global South inherit tokenization and knowledge disadvantages from U.S. and China-based pretrained base models. Tokenization premiums reach 10x for Amharic and 1.6–2.7x for Indigenous South American languages.
takeaways: Tokenization premiums: 10x for Amharic, 6.8x for Amharic in newest tokenizer
Indigenous South American languages: 1.6–2.7x premiums
Portuguese vocabulary reduces premiums by ~24% for Guarani and Quechua
Fine-tuning does not alter inherited vocabulary, knowledge, cultural alignment, memorized data

evidence-traceable-clinical-reasoning-be.title: Evidence-traceable clinical reasoning benchmark for medical language models
evidence-traceable-clinical-reasoning-be.one_liner: Researchers from China developed Med Evidence Bench (MEB), a 1,536-item benchmark evaluating clinical reasoning in medical LLMs with evidence-traceable scoring. Evaluation of ten models found scores of 0.975–0.997 for guideline knowledge but 0.182–0.447 for real-world scenarios.
takeaways: 1,536-item benchmark across 3 levels: guideline knowledge, standardized scenarios, real-world scenarios
Evidence Trace Scores: 0.975–0.997 (guideline), 0.292–0.658 (standardized), 0.182–0.447 (real-world)
Automated grading achieved macro-F1 agreement of 0.930 (95% CI 0.915–0.945) with physician vote
Materials in Chinese; submitted to arXiv Nov 10, 2026

spain-holds-first-general-strike-in-14-y.title: Spain Holds First General Strike in 14 Years Amid Housing and Social Unrest
spain-holds-first-general-strike-in-14-y.one_liner: Spain held its first general strike in 14 years on November 11, with millions of workers disrupting transport and businesses to protest housing costs and social inequality. Strike participation reached 90% in automotive, 85% in meat, and 75% in energy sectors.
takeaways: First general strike in 14 years; held Nov 11, 2026
Participation: 90% automotive/ports, 85% meat, 82% waste, 75% energy
Average rent nearly doubled over past decade
Average rent in Spain nearly doubled over past decade; strike galvanized by televised eviction of 87-year-old woman

russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-no.title: Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, November 10, 2026
russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-no.one_liner: The Institute for the Study of War assessed Russia's ongoing offensive operations and strategic objectives in Ukraine and Eastern Europe.

ukraines-eu-accession-path-narrows-as-wa.title: Ukraine's EU Accession Path Narrows as War Continues
ukraines-eu-accession-path-narrows-as-wa.one_liner: Ukraine's prospects for European Union membership are becoming increasingly limited as the ongoing war with Russia persists.

spain-stages-first-general-strike-in-14-.title: Spain Stages First General Strike in 14 Years Over Housing Crisis
spain-stages-first-general-strike-in-14-.one_liner: Spanish workers have launched their first general strike in 14 years to protest the country's housing affordability crisis.

ukraine-and-russia-agree-on-prisoner-swa.title: Ukraine and Russia Agree on Prisoner Swap, Moscow Resists European Mediation
ukraine-and-russia-agree-on-prisoner-swa.one_liner: Ukraine and Russia have reached an agreement on a prisoner exchange, though Moscow remains resistant to European involvement in broader peace talks.

anthropic-expands-claude-workplace-suite.title: Anthropic expands Claude workplace suite with Sheets, Meetings, and Whiteboards
anthropic-expands-claude-workplace-suite.one_liner: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, Whiteboards, and Sheets as workplace productivity tools. Claude Meetings enables AI participation in video calls with notes and action item capture; Whiteboards provide shared brainstorming space; Sheets allows collaborative spreadsheet creation with formulas and formatting.
takeaways: Claude Meetings: AI as visible participant with conversation follow-up and information retrieval
Claude Whiteboards: shared visual workspace converting boards to documents/slides; beta for paid subscribers
Claude Sheets: collaborative spreadsheet creation with formulas and dropdown menus
Launch competes with OpenAI workplace tools and Meta's Muse AI agent

anthropic-launches-ipo-roadshow-with-64b.title: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow with $64B fundraising target
anthropic-launches-ipo-roadshow-with-64b.one_liner: Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow targeting $64.35 billion in fundraising with 825 million shares at $70–$78 per share. Seven co-founders will each net approximately $250 million; Goldman Sachs projects $52 billion 2026 revenue and tenfold growth by 2030.
takeaways: Roadshow launched Nov 10, 2026; pricing scheduled Nov 18; Nasdaq ticker 'ANT'
$17 billion Q3 2026 revenue; $536 million operating loss that quarter
7x more revenue first 9 months 2026 vs. all of 2025
Seven major suppliers (Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, TSMC) committed to $26B share purchase

uk-foreign-secretary-warns-climate-crisi.title: UK Foreign Secretary Warns Climate Crisis Poses National Security Risk to All Countries
uk-foreign-secretary-warns-climate-crisi.one_liner: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband warned at COP31 that climate crisis poses national security risk to all countries. He stated climate impacts now regularly produce outcomes previously considered science fiction.
takeaways: Climate impacts regularly producing outcomes previously considered science fiction
Poses national security risk to all countries

developing-nations-left-in-limbo-as-rich.title: Developing Nations Left in Limbo as Rich Countries Delay Climate Finance Plans
developing-nations-left-in-limbo-as-rich.one_liner: Developing countries struggle to plan climate investments as major developed economies have not finalized climate finance commitments beyond 2025-2026. Projections suggest $229 billion annually by 2030, nearing the $300 billion COP29 goal, but lack of public disclosure prevents recipient nations from securing private investment.
takeaways: COP29 goal: $300 billion annually from developed nations by 2035
Projected 2030 climate finance: ~$229 billion annually (on track for goal)
Multilateral development banks expected to provide ~$185 billion of $229 billion
Delayed disclosure prevents developing nations from setting targets and attracting private investment

bird-flu-causes-catastrophic-wildlife-di.title: Bird Flu Causes Catastrophic Wildlife Die-Offs, Raising Extinction Risk Concerns
bird-flu-causes-catastrophic-wildlife-di.one_liner: Bird flu (H5N1) has triggered catastrophic wildlife die-offs, prompting the IUCN to upgrade the southern elephant seal to vulnerable status in April 2026—the first species explicitly downgraded due to avian influenza. On South Georgia, more than 53,000 female seals died by 2025.
takeaways: H5N1 now conservation threat to at least 40 bird species (BirdLife International)
Southern elephant seal: first species upgraded to vulnerable explicitly due to avian influenza
South Georgia: 53,000+ female seals died by 2025; >90% pup mortality in some colonies
Strain circulating northern hemisphere since 2021; now in 4 of 5 southern elephant seal populations

united-states-at-risk-of-losing-measles-.title: United States at risk of losing measles elimination status due to ongoing outbreaks
united-states-at-risk-of-losing-measles-.one_liner: The United States faces potential loss of its measles elimination status following recent outbreaks. A WHO regional committee is expected to decide this week whether the U.S. retains the status it achieved in 2000.
takeaways: At least 8 measles deaths reported in 2026
Decision expected from Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) committee this week
Loss of status previously described as unavoidable consequence of transmission patterns

indias-air-pollution-monitors-overwhelme.title: India's Air Pollution Monitors Overwhelmed by Record Toxic Smog
indias-air-pollution-monitors-overwhelme.one_liner: Air pollution monitors in New Delhi were overwhelmed by toxic smog during Diwali celebrations, registering concentrations exceeding 1,000 mcg/m³—approximately 66 times the WHO daily maximum. Official records captured gaps during peak pollution, though authorities attributed this to calibration limits.
takeaways: Pollution exceeded monitor limit of 1,000 mcg/m³ (66x WHO daily max of 15 mcg/m³)
Mandir Marg recorded 879 mcg/m³ when monitors resumed ~8 hours after peak
Pollution monitors calibrated when National Air Quality Index introduced in 2015
CPCB characterized data gaps as measurement system limitations during extreme episodes

huawei-unveils-supercluster-ai-architect.title: Huawei Unveils SuperCluster AI Architecture for Unified 1 Million-Chip Computing
huawei-unveils-supercluster-ai-architect.one_liner: Huawei introduces the Peerium architecture enabling up to 1 million AI chips to operate as a single computer with 40 trillion parameter training capability.

new-imaging-technique-reveals-hidden-exo.title: New imaging technique reveals hidden exoplanets in James Webb data
new-imaging-technique-reveals-hidden-exo.one_liner: Astronomers developed an imaging technique using a digital twin of James Webb's Near Infrared Camera to remove stellar glare, making exoplanets 2–15 times easier to detect. The method has already uncovered a previously hidden exoplanet in existing JWST observations.
takeaways: Technique makes exoplanets 2–15x easier to detect than conventional methods
Uses digital twin of NIRCam to simulate and subtract stellar glare
Combines physical instrument model with machine learning optimization
Published in Nature Nov 4, 2026; already found hidden exoplanet in existing JWST data

microsoft-patches-1259-vulnerabilities-i.title: Microsoft patches 1,259 vulnerabilities including exploited Outlook flaw; patch volume exceeds 1,000 for second consecutive month
microsoft-patches-1259-vulnerabilities-i.one_liner: Microsoft released 1,259 security patches on November 11, the second consecutive month exceeding 1,000 vulnerabilities. Updates include 63 critical flaws and address an actively exploited zero-day in Microsoft Outlook that leaks NTLMv2 hashes without user warning.
takeaways: 1,259 total vulnerabilities: 726 Windows, 174 Office, 61 Developer Tools, 59 SQL Server, 27 SharePoint
Moderate-severity Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194, CVSS 6.5) actively exploited
Over 5,100 CVEs addressed in 2026 to date
CISA deadline for federal agencies: Nov 24, 2026

n-able-patches-zero-day-vulnerabilities-.title: N-able patches zero-day vulnerabilities in N-central RMM platform
n-able-patches-zero-day-vulnerabilities-.one_liner: N-able responded to public disclosure of critical zero-day vulnerabilities in its N-central RMM platform by taking hosted environments offline. A GitHub account published 33 alleged vulnerabilities including unauthenticated XXE injection chainable to RCE.
takeaways: 33 alleged vulnerabilities disclosed under title 'Able2Shell' on GitHub
Unauthenticated XXE injection can chain into remote code execution
N-central manages systems, deploys software, and maintains privileged access to endpoints
No active exploitation observed at time of advisory

emudhra-revokes-8-additional-cas-followi.title: eMudhra revokes 8 additional CAs following earlier key compromise
emudhra-revokes-8-additional-cas-followi.one_liner: Certificate authority eMudhra revoked 8 more intermediate certificate authorities as fallout from its October key compromise incident, despite these CAs not having weakened keys.

siemens-and-industrial-control-systems-f.title: Siemens and Industrial Control Systems Face High-Severity Vulnerabilities Ahead of Patch Tuesday
siemens-and-industrial-control-systems-f.one_liner: Multiple critical flaws in industrial equipment from Siemens, Phoenix Contact, Johnson Controls, and Hitachi Energy require immediate patching.

intel-and-amd-patch-over-200-vulnerabili.title: Intel and AMD Patch Over 200 Vulnerabilities in Chipmaker Patch Tuesday
intel-and-amd-patch-over-200-vulnerabili.one_liner: Intel and AMD disclosed more than 200 security vulnerabilities, including critical flaws in Intel TDX and multiple AMD graphics bugs.

iran-rejects-removal-of-enriched-nuclear.title: Iran rejects removal of enriched nuclear material from country
iran-rejects-removal-of-enriched-nuclear.one_liner: Iran's Foreign Ministry rejected proposals to remove enriched uranium from the country. Spokesman Baqaei addressed threats from the president of the United States to attack nuclear facilities and linked reopening the Strait of Hormuz to ending the U.S. naval blockade.
takeaways: Iran rejects transfer or removal of enriched uranium from country
Baqaei referenced late Leader's religious decree prohibiting nuclear weapons production
Addressed president of United States threats to attack nuclear facilities
Linked Strait of Hormuz reopening to lifting sanctions and releasing frozen assets

lebanon-faces-economic-catastrophe-follo.title: Lebanon Faces Economic Catastrophe Following War and Years of Government Mismanagement
lebanon-faces-economic-catastrophe-follo.one_liner: Lebanon's economy faces severe crisis following the March 2024 conflict and sustained fiscal mismanagement. The World Bank projects inflation will rise over 17% and economy will contract 6.4% in 2026, with approximately 80% of the population in poverty.
takeaways: World Bank projection: inflation >17%, economy contraction 6.4% in 2026
Grape farmer fuel prices doubled, labor costs increased 5x, crop prices fell 50% since conflict
Approximately 80% of Lebanon's population in poverty
Conflict killed thousands, displaced hundreds of thousands; Nov 2024 ceasefire incomplete

microsoft-researchers-demonstrate-ai-age.title: Microsoft Researchers Demonstrate AI Agents Can Be Backdoored by Editing Fewer Than 10 Neurons
microsoft-researchers-demonstrate-ai-age.one_liner: Microsoft researchers demonstrated that AI agents can be backdoored by editing fewer than 10 neurons in open-weight models without retraining. The technique, called Lazarus, enables malicious command execution when triggered by specific strings.
takeaways: Nemotron-Terminal-8B: 7 neurons edited (98.8% success rate with 23 training sessions)
Qwen3.6-27B: 6 neurons edited (51-99.5% success rates)
Gemma-4-31B-IT: 99.5% success rates
Requires access to model checkpoint file before deployment; no threat actors observed using technique
Nemotron-Terminal-8B: 7 neurons edited, 98.8% success rate, 23 training sessions
Technique works on Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma-4-31B-IT models
No retraining required; allows attacker-controlled command execution with agent permissions
No threat actors observed using technique in the wild

anthropic-ipo-priced-at-7078-range-valui.title: Anthropic IPO priced at $70–$78 range, valuing the company at up to $1.4 trillion
anthropic-ipo-priced-at-7078-range-valui.one_liner: Anthropic priced its IPO at $70–$78 per share, targeting $57.75–$64.35 billion in gross proceeds. The company also pursues a $26 billion private placement with strategic partners contingent on IPO completion.
takeaways: IPO pricing $70–$78 per share; 825 million shares proposed
Gross proceeds target: $57.75–$64.35 billion
Primary offering: 801.35 million shares (Anthropic); secondary: 23.65 million (existing shareholders)
Separate $26 billion private placement with strategic partners contingent on IPO completion

earliest-known-quasar-pair-challenges-bl.title: Earliest known quasar pair challenges black hole growth theory
earliest-known-quasar-pair-challenges-bl.one_liner: Astronomers discovered the earliest known compact quasar pair approximately 900 million years after the Big Bang, raising questions about rapid early supermassive black hole growth. The double system was observed with the Hubble Space Telescope during the era known as cosmic noon.
takeaways: Earliest compact quasar pair at ~900 million years post-Big Bang
Discovery challenges models of early supermassive black hole formation and rapid growth
Observed during 'cosmic noon' (peak of star and black hole formation)
Researchers used cosmological simulations spanning 10 million to 4 billion years post-Big Bang

over-35000-grok-built-apps-exposed-onlin.title: Over 35,000 Grok-built apps exposed online with leaked credentials
over-35000-grok-built-apps-exposed-onlin.one_liner: Security researchers found 35,578 of 37,571 Grok-built applications publicly accessible without authentication, with 24 apps created by X and SpaceX staff leaking confidential data including sales proposals, employee lists, and passwords. Exposed organizations included six Fortune 500 companies and 26 organizations with over 1,000 employees.
takeaways: 35,578 of 37,571 Grok apps publicly accessible without authentication (94.7%)
24 apps by X/SpaceX staff leaked onboarding plans, sales maps, confidential proposals, employee data
Internal data exposed from 30 organizations across construction, energy, healthcare, defense sectors
~2% of open apps contained high or critical severity material

spacex-starship-flight-15-first-ever-dou.title: SpaceX Starship Flight 15: First-Ever Double Booster Landing Attempt on November 13
spacex-starship-flight-15-first-ever-dou.one_liner: SpaceX will attempt Starship Flight 15 on November 13, featuring the first-ever attempt to catch both the Super Heavy booster and Ship simultaneously.

russia-shuts-down-novaya-gazeta-last-maj.title: Russia Shuts Down Novaya Gazeta, Last Major Independent Newspaper
russia-shuts-down-novaya-gazeta-last-maj.one_liner: Novaya Gazeta, Russia's last major independent newspaper, closed after 33 years following pressure from authorities. Staff spent final days preserving archives spanning three decades of newsroom history.
takeaways: Closed after 33 years of operation
Closure announced Oct 30, 2026
Staff worked overnight to preserve archives, back issues, books, photographs
